title: Not inside an Syrp repository
cause: No directory at or above the current one holds both ownership.toml and a workspace Cargo.toml.
fix: cd into the syrp checkout, or pass --root <path>.

title: Unknown error code
cause: `explain` was given a code that is not in errors/*.toml, or no code at all.
fix: Run `cargo syrp explain --list` to see every code.

title: Input file unreadable or not valid JSON
cause: A file passed with --issues, --prs, --pr, --issue or to `review validate` could not be read or parsed.
fix: Check the path, and that the file came from the documented `gh ... --json` command.

title: Git diff failed
cause: The ownership check diffs against a base ref (default origin/main) that is not available locally.
fix: Run `git fetch origin main`, or pass --base <ref>.

title: Invalid command line
cause: The arguments did not parse.
fix: Run `cargo syrp --help` or `cargo syrp <command> --help`.

title: Tool missing
cause: A required program (cargo, rustc, git, rustfmt, clippy) or an optional one (gh, mdbook, cargo-nextest, cargo-deny) is not installed.
fix: Install it. `cargo syrp doctor` lists what is missing and what each tool is for.

title: Toolchain differs from the pinned one
cause: rustc on PATH is not the version in rust-toolchain.toml.
fix: Inside the repo rustup switches automatically. Otherwise run `rustup toolchain install` in the repo root.

title: Formatting differs from rustfmt
cause: `cargo fmt --all -- --check` found unformatted code.
fix: Run `cargo fmt --all` and commit the result.

title: Clippy reported warnings
cause: `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` failed. Warnings are errors in this repo.
fix: Fix each lint. Do not add `#[allow]` without a comment explaining why; reviewers reject unexplained allows.

title: Layer or sibling violation
cause: A crate depends on a crate in a higher layer, or on a sibling in the same group (master plan §5.3). Dev-dependencies are exempt.
fix: Depend on the contract (`*-api`) crate instead, or move the shared code down a layer through a change request.
example: syrp-rt (L0) may not depend on syrp-audio-api (L1).

title: Banned dependency
cause: Cargo.lock contains a crate banned for clean-room reasons (for example `aloe-*`, a self-described JUCE translation).
fix: Remove the dependency. Do not read its source. If it came in transitively, file a change request.

title: Source file too large
cause: A .rs file is longer than 1200 lines. Large files are hard for agents and reviewers to hold in context.
fix: Split the module into smaller files.

title: Crate metadata or AGENTS.md missing
cause: Every workspace crate needs `[package.metadata.syrp] layer = "L0".."L7"` and an AGENTS.md.
fix: Add both. The AGENTS.md headings are in docs/agents/crate-agents-template.md.

title: Review file inside the repository
cause: A review.json at the repository root could be mistaken for, or published as, a reviewer's verdict.
fix: Delete it. Reviewer agents write their review to a path outside the checkout that the workflow chooses.

title: Tests failed
cause: cargo test reported failures. The diagnostic carries the tail of the output.
fix: Fix the failing tests. Never delete or ignore a test to get green.

title: Could not write documentation output
cause: `docs build` failed to read a source or write into the output directory.
fix: Check permissions and disk space for the --out directory.

title: mdBook build failed
cause: The human documentation site did not build, usually a broken link in docs/SUMMARY.md or a missing page.
fix: Run `mdbook build` locally and fix the reported page.

title: Work package or wave file invalid
cause: A file in work/packages/ or work/waves/ (or ownership.toml) failed to parse, has unknown keys, or its file name differs from its id.
fix: Compare with work/wp.schema.json and an existing spec, for example work/packages/WP-0.1-03.toml.

title: Unknown work package
cause: A command or wave referenced a WP id with no file in work/packages/.
fix: Run `cargo syrp wp list` for valid ids.

title: Dependency on unknown work package
cause: `depends_on` names a WP that does not exist.
fix: Fix the id or add the missing WP (spec-room work).

title: Dependency cycle
cause: Work packages depend on each other in a loop, so none of them can ever start.
fix: Break the cycle, usually by moving the shared part into a contract crate WP.

title: Path outside the work package's ownership
cause: A change touches a file the WP does not own: another crate, or a shared file owned by a role (master plan §12.4).
fix: Revert the change. For shared files (workspace Cargo.toml, CI, deny.toml...) open a change-request issue; the PR manager applies it.

title: Two work packages own the same path
cause: Overlapping ownership would let two agents edit the same files at once.
fix: Give each path to exactly one WP.

title: Spec file missing
cause: The WP's `spec` path does not exist.
fix: Write the spec under work/specs/ (spec room) before scheduling the WP.

title: Owned crate does not exist yet
cause: `wp check` ran for a WP whose crate directory has no Cargo.toml yet.
fix: Create the crate: Cargo.toml using workspace inheritance, [package.metadata.syrp] layer, AGENTS.md, src/lib.rs. Workspace members are globbed, so no root edit is needed.

title: PR too large
cause: More than 1200 changed lines (Cargo.lock excluded). Large PRs get worse reviews.
fix: Split the WP into several PRs; only the last carries `"final": true`.

title: CI is red
cause: At least one required check failed (gate G1).
fix: Reproduce locally with the same `cargo syrp` command the job ran, fix, and push.

title: Reviewer requested changes
cause: The `syrp/review` status is failure (gate G2).
fix: Address every requested change in the review comment; the conductor schedules a revision automatically.

title: Adversarial verifier rejected the PR
cause: The PR is high-risk (public API, unsafe, FFI, wrappers, licensing, CI, contracts or new dependencies) and the `syrp/adversarial` status is failure (gate G10).
fix: Address the verifier's findings; its attack tests usually show the failing case.

title: PR front matter missing or invalid
cause: The body must contain `<!-- syrp-pr: {json} -->` naming a known WP (or kind change-request), with risk categories only from: public-api, unsafe, ffi, plugin-wrapper, licensing, ci-infra, contract-change, supply-chain, rt-safety.
fix: Use the PR template. Example: <!-- syrp-pr: {"wp":"WP-0.1-03","final":true,"risk":[],"deps_added":[],"unsafe_count":0} -->

title: Provenance trailers missing
cause: Every commit needs `WP: <id>` (or `Change-Request: <n>`) and `Agent-Model: <model>` trailers (master plan §10.5).
fix: Amend or reword the commits on your own branch to add the trailers, then force-push the branch.

title: Review file invalid
cause: The reviewer's JSON is malformed, is for a different PR or review kind than the one being published, skips a checklist item, passes an item without evidence, or lists no commands run.
fix: Answer every item from `cargo syrp review checklist` with evidence from commands you ran yourself.

title: Restarts exhausted
cause: Fresh agents lost the WP's lease (crashed, timed out or produced no PR) more times than budget.max_restarts.
fix: Spec room: split or clarify the WP, then remove `needs-human` and reset the lease marker. Escalation E5.

title: Review rounds exhausted
cause: The PR still has changes requested after budget.max_review_rounds rounds. Escalation E1.
fix: Read the review thread. Either clarify the spec, arbitrate, or close the PR and re-plan the WP.

title: Work package needs a person
cause: The WP's role is `human` or `oracle` (accounts, legal, hardware, or the separate juce-oracle repository), which agents in this repository cannot do.
fix: Do the task, then close the issue (or merge its PR). Dependants start automatically.
